subgoals.title: Windows定期受信の実行証跡を安全に監査する
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a read-only local operator check that verifies the exact pinned Windows scheduled-task action, last-run result and next trigger without registering, triggering, editing or deleting a task.

Check local receipt-ledger SHA against the staged plan file and distinguish never-run, duplicate receipt, newly received plan and failed or pending-review states without changing LIVE state or invoking Codex.
Provide offline tests for missing scheduler task, never-run status, nonzero result, valid receipt and modified staged bytes; preserve the existing regression tests.
